items.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: to see Benny Waters, 93 years young playing the horn better than most people can play at the age of 23, was just a thrill.

ctx.x: Boy he was never at a loss for a line, was he? Well what do you think of this particular festival here at Sarasota?

Well I love the festival. I’ve been disappointed with this year’s edition, certainly not with the number of musicians and the wealth of their abilities, but I didn’t think the first night clicked. I’m a Jazz at the Phil fan, it’s one of my favorites. To be told that I’m going to get a chance to listen to jam session and then a ballad medley with all of these great artists, I would have expected a lot more. I just didn’t think it gelled. It didn’t come together for some reason. I’m not sure I know why, but I’ve…

I’m thinking of wearing neck brace, because I know they’re going to take my head off when they hit that first chord, after hearing them this afternoon. You know I think someone could make a good living being a jazz sound man. I think that we have, I don’t know if we’ve demanded over the years, to make things louder, but it seems they don’t allow the musicians to set anything themselves somehow.
